# Astronomy Engine 2.1.19

`astronomy.py` is the unmodified file `astronomy/astronomy.py` from the PyPI wheel
`astronomy_engine-2.1.19-py3-none-any.whl` (SHA-256 of the wheel:
`232ba7dd2bbf42225c48be6721b676e8c6c079dbd4588d2781dfa68adcb6f67f`).

- Upstream: https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy
- Author: Don Cross
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE` in this folder. The CC0 dedication of the rest of
  the repository does not apply to these files.

Only `scripts/build_sun.py` loads it. Its SHA-256 is pinned in the `time.ephemeris_engine`
section of `ladoga-definitions.json`; do not edit the file, replace it with a new release instead.
